text:
A student splashes water on to her face. Here are three statements about the effects.
P
The water uses energy to evaporate.
Q
The water gains energy from the student.
R
The face of the student cools.
Which statements are correct?
A
P and Q only
B
P and R only
C
Q and R only
D
P, Q and R
subject: Physics
